text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...It didn't quite turn out to be the best 
result, did it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I really wanted to bring home a victory, 
but... I fell just a bit short. It's truly 
disappointing."
choice_data_list:
Your skill levels were close, so luck 
played a part too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your concern. However... I 
cannot allow myself to lean on those words 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If we're aiming for the top, it's at times 
like this that we must carefully look for 
lessons to learn.
choice_data_list:
If you can maintain that perspective, 
you'll grow more than anyone.

Let's thoroughly eliminate every reason 
for defeat other than luck!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is what I strive to be.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Winning or losing is important, of 
course... but the knowledge and experience 
gained from a race are just as vital."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Because someday, when you walk the path 
of a mentor, that experience is sure to be 
invaluable."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
For that purpose, I want to learn as much 
as possible ...from the mentor known as 
you.
choice_data_list: Of course, leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Yes. I'm counting on you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. As long as it's a competition, 
luck will always play a part to some 
degree.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However, with proper training and 
learning, we should be able to minimize 
that as much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Now, let us be on our way, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"What we need to do before our next race 
is clear. We have no time to waste, after 
all."
